newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real rises 0.04 pct on dollar inflows.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real rises 0.04 pct on dollar inflows.

text.p: Brazil's real rose 0.04 percent to close at 1.0161 reais against the dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market due to dollar inflows, dealers said.
The Central Bank bought dollars at 1.0160 real per greenback to drain excess dollars from the market in the late afternoon.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Monday surplus of around $110 million, dealers said.
Apart from dollar inflows, the U.S.'s Labor Day holiday also contributed to the calm forex market session today.
Banks expect another quiet trading day Tuesday due to the lack of market-moving news, they added.
In the interbank foreign exchange floating rate market, the real closed steady at 1.0211 to the dollar.
In the illegal parallel market, the real rose 0.1 percent to end at 1.028 per greenback, traders said.
